name: Bohdalice-Pavlovice (Czechia)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and blue, with a white fleur-de-lis in the red at the hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 2 November 2001 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
